description: List items and folders, newest first. By default the root level; pass folder_id for a folder's direct contents, plus include_subfolders for everything nested under it. Paginated via meta.next_page_url / total_pages. Sortly: GET /api/v1/items.

folder_id.description: Only the direct contents of this folder. Omit for the root level.

include.description: Nested associations to embed: custom_attributes and/or photos.

include_subfolders.description: With folder_id: also return everything nested beneath it. Default false.

name: sortly_list_items
title: List items and folders
